notes: Samsung's spec table prints Folded/Unfolded as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH -- the second value is identical folded and unfolded (the hinge-axis dimension), so it is mapped to `height` and the first value to `width`. Two folded thicknesses: 15.8mm '(Hinge)' and 14.2mm '(Sagging)'. Larger (15.8) -> closed.depth and hinge-side (15.8) -> depth_at_hinge; 14.2mm is the non-hinge side. Cover-screen refresh is published as an adaptive range 48~120Hz; the maximum (120) is recorded. Main screen range is 1~120Hz.
